name: Filter
description: One tool for photo effects: pick halftone, scanline, posterize, voronoi, dither or ASCII art (vector) or duotone, pixel-stretch, imperfections or glitch (raster). Brand overlays, live camera, and exports to as many formats as each effect supports.

featured.blurb: Ten photo effects, vector or raster, in one tool

inputs.label: Effect
inputs.help: The effect to apply. Vector effects export crisp SVG/PDF; raster effects export images.

inputs.label: Image
inputs.help: Pick a photo or upload your own. It's processed on your device - the pixels never leave the browser.

inputs.label: Grid size
inputs.help: Spacing between dots. Smaller = finer detail and more dots; larger = a bolder, coarser screen.

inputs.label: Dot size
inputs.help: Scales every dot. Below 1 opens up the screen; above 1 fattens the dots so darks fill in.

inputs.label: Smoothing
inputs.help: Softens the dot grid by blurring neighbouring cells. Tames noisy photos.

inputs.label: Texture
inputs.help: Adds a newspaper-style 1-bit texture by snapping cells to full or empty dots.

inputs.label: Colour source
inputs.help: Colour the dots from the photo underneath, or a single ink.

inputs.label: Colour levels
inputs.help: Reduce the dot colours to a limited palette (levels per channel). Full keeps the photo's colours.

inputs.label: Dot colour
inputs.help: Dot colour when Colour source is Solid.

inputs.label: Transparent background
inputs.help: Drop the fill so the dots sit on transparency, ready to drop onto any design (PNG / SVG).

inputs.label: Background
inputs.help: Fill behind the dots. Turn on “Transparent background” for no fill instead.

inputs.label: Invert
inputs.help: Grow dots for the light areas instead of the dark - ideal for a light colour on a dark background.

inputs.label: Gamma
inputs.help: Mid-tone weighting. Below 1 darkens mid-tones (denser dots); above 1 lightens them.

inputs.label: Line height
inputs.help: Height of each scanline and the size of each cell, so smaller means thinner lines and finer detail.

inputs.label: Gap height
inputs.help: Size of the blank gap below each scanline, relative to the line. Larger = thinner lines with more space between them; 0 makes a solid image with no gaps. Doesn't change the detail or position of the image.

inputs.label: Separate pixels
inputs.help: Add a gap between cells too, so each one is a distinct square - an LED/pixel-matrix look instead of solid scanline bars.

inputs.label: Fill every line
inputs.help: Draw every line with no gaps - the same as setting the gap height to zero. Off = classic scanlines; on = a solid posterised image.

inputs.label: Highlight
inputs.help: Brightest tone.

inputs.label: Shadow
inputs.help: Darkest tone.

inputs.label: Background
inputs.help: Fills the blank lines and gaps. Leave empty for a transparent background (PNG/WebP/AVIF/SVG keep the transparency).

inputs.label: Colour steps
inputs.help: How many tonal separations to trace. Changing this re-samples the colours from the photo.

inputs.label: Threshold (1 ink)
inputs.help: Collapse the photo to a single ink over paper - one hard cut between dark and light instead of graded separations. Pair with Transparent background for ink on nothing.

inputs.label: Threshold level
inputs.help: Where the cut between ink and paper falls. Higher turns more of the photo into ink; lower keeps only the deepest shadows.

inputs.label: Quality
inputs.help: Tracing resolution - higher samples the photo at a finer grid and captures more detail. Above 100 pushes into very fine, slower traces.

inputs.label: Smoothing
inputs.help: How much the traced outlines round into curves. Low keeps edges faithful and crisp; high flows them into smooth Bézier curves.

inputs.label: Re-sample colours from photo
inputs.help: Discard manual edits and re-derive every separation colour from the current photo.

inputs.label: Brightness
inputs.help: Lighten or darken the photo before it is separated - shifts every tone up or down, moving detail between the light and dark separations.

inputs.label: Invert tones
inputs.help: Trace from inverted tones - the photo's bright areas become the foreground separations (a tonal negative). Useful for a light subject on a dark background.

inputs.label: Separation colours
inputs.help: One swatch per tone, darkest first and the lightest (paper) last. Auto-sampled from your photo - edit any swatch to recolour that separation.

inputs.label: Transparent background
inputs.help: Drop the lightest 'paper' separation so the background is transparent (PNG / SVG).

inputs.label: Background
inputs.help: Paper colour behind the separations. Leave empty to use the lightest palette swatch.

inputs.label: Cells
inputs.help: How many Voronoi cells to shatter the image into. More cells = finer, more faithful; fewer = bold, chunky facets.

inputs.label: Irregularity
inputs.help: 0 = a regular grid of cells · 100 = fully scattered, organic cell shapes.

inputs.label: Relax (even out)
inputs.help: Lloyd relaxation - nudges cells toward equal size and rounder shapes. Higher is calmer and more uniform.

inputs.label: Seed (reroll)
inputs.help: Reroll the random cell layout. Same seed = same cells every time.

inputs.label: Edge width
inputs.help: Mortar between cells. 0 = a seamless colour mesh; higher draws a gap in the edge colour for a stained-glass look.

inputs.label: Edge colour
inputs.help: The colour of the gaps between cells (and the outer border).

inputs.label: Transparent background
inputs.help: Drop the background so any gaps / border are transparent (PNG / SVG).

inputs.label: Background
inputs.help: The colour behind the mesh - the border and any export margins. Leave empty to follow the edge colour.

inputs.label: Treatment
inputs.help: Recolour the photo through your brand palette in OKLab. Leave the colours below empty to auto-pick from the brand's tokens; set them to override.

inputs.label: Treatment amount
inputs.help: Blend between the untreated photo (0) and the full treatment (100).

inputs.label: Shadow colour
inputs.help: Empty = auto: the darkest colour in your brand palette.

inputs.label: Midtone colour
inputs.help: Empty = auto: the most colourful swatch in your brand palette.

inputs.label: Highlight colour
inputs.help: Empty = auto: the lightest colour in your brand palette.

inputs.label: Zoom & Position
inputs.help: Drag the photo on the canvas to move it, scroll to zoom, and hold Alt while dragging to correct converging verticals. Or drag a label / type a value here.

inputs.label: Direction
inputs.help: Which way the frozen column of pixels smears across the frame.

inputs.label: Threshold start
inputs.help: Where the photo freezes. Past this line the frozen column stretches, then the rest of the photo continues at its natural proportions, clipped at the far edge.

inputs.label: Spread
inputs.help: How much of the space past the threshold the frozen column fills. The rest of the photo slides in after it at its natural proportions (clipped at the edge). 0 = untouched photo; 100 = the column stretches all the way to the edge.

inputs.label: Feather
inputs.help: Softens the seam where the photo meets the frozen column. The far end, where the column hands off to the sliding remainder, is already colour-continuous, so this mainly affects the start seam. 0 keeps a hard edge.

inputs.label: Zoom & Position
inputs.help: Drag the photo on the canvas to move it, scroll to zoom, and hold Alt while dragging to correct converging verticals. Or drag a label / type a value here.

inputs.label: Press character
inputs.help: A ready-made recipe of misregistration, ink bleed and wear. Pick Custom to fine-tune each imperfection yourself.

inputs.label: Strength
inputs.help: Scales every imperfection at once. 0 is a clean print; 100 is the full recipe.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Changes the plate jitter and textures. The same seed always gives the same result.

inputs.label: Ink 1
inputs.help: First ink for the two-ink looks (the Risograph preset, or Custom with Two inks). Defaults to the brand's primary.

inputs.label: Ink 2
inputs.help: Second ink for the two-ink looks. Defaults to the brand's secondary.

inputs.label: Ink plates
inputs.help: How the artwork is separated into printing plates before they are misprinted.

inputs.label: Misregistration
inputs.help: How far the ink plates drift out of alignment, in canvas units.

inputs.label: Ink bleed
inputs.help: Softens and roughens edges as if the ink soaked into the paper.

inputs.label: Photocopy wear
inputs.help: Washes out colour, hardens the tones and adds copier streaks.

inputs.label: Paper tint
inputs.help: The colour of the paper stock the print sits on.

inputs.label: Tint strength
inputs.help: How far the paper shifts from bright white toward the tint. Blended perceptually, so mid-strengths stay clean.

inputs.label: Paper grain
inputs.help: Speckle of the paper tooth showing through the ink.

inputs.label: Algorithm
inputs.help: How each pixel's colour error is spread to its neighbours before the next match.

inputs.label: Scale
inputs.help: Size of each virtual pixel. Smaller now keeps getting finer (a much larger cell budget), so the low end reads as crisp detail instead of plateauing; larger reads as a bolder, chunkier print.

inputs.label: Palette
inputs.help: The fixed set of colours every pixel snaps to. Brand palette quantizes through your active brand's colour tokens.

inputs.label: Colour count
inputs.help: How many brand swatches to quantize to.

inputs.label: Character ramp
inputs.help: The characters used from lightest to darkest.

inputs.label: Cell size
inputs.help: Size of each character cell. Smaller reads more of the photo's detail.

inputs.label: Character weight
inputs.help: Stroke weight of every character. Bolder fills the cell more; lighter opens it up.

inputs.label: Threshold
inputs.help: Where the mid-tone falls in the light-to-character mapping. 50 is neutral; lower pushes more of the photo toward the dense end of the ramp, higher toward the light end.

inputs.label: Colour mode
inputs.help: Mono draws every character in one ink; per-cell colours each character from the photo underneath.

inputs.label: Character colour
inputs.help: Ink colour when Colour mode is Mono or Foreground on background.

inputs.label: Background
inputs.help: Fill behind the characters. Leave empty for a transparent background.

inputs.label: Invert
inputs.help: Swap the ramp - dense characters for light areas instead of dark.

inputs.label: Pixel sort threshold
inputs.help: Brightness above this line gets swept into a sorted streak. 0 turns pixel sort off.

inputs.label: Band length
inputs.help: Caps how long a sorted streak can run before it breaks. 0 = uncapped.

inputs.label: Red offset
inputs.help: Shifts the red channel. Drag a label or type a value.

inputs.label: Green offset
inputs.help: Shifts the green channel.

inputs.label: Blue offset
inputs.help: Shifts the blue channel.

inputs.label: Block corruption
inputs.help: How much of the image breaks into corrupted blocks. Seeded, so the same seed always corrupts the same blocks. 0 turns it off.

inputs.label: Seed
inputs.help: Reroll which blocks corrupt and how. Same seed = same result every time.

inputs.label: Hue
inputs.help: Rotate every colour around the wheel.

inputs.label: Saturation
inputs.help: 0 = greyscale · 100 = original · 200 = vivid.

inputs.label: Lightness
inputs.help: Lift toward white or sink toward black.

inputs.label: Colour treatment
inputs.help: Blend a colour over the result. Leave empty for none.

inputs.label: Blend mode
inputs.help: How the treatment colour mixes with the image.

inputs.label: Intensity
inputs.help: Opacity of the colour overlay.

inputs.label: No filter (show raw)
inputs.help: Show the original photo or live camera feed untouched - handy for placing just a logo / lower-third over the raw footage.

inputs.label: Brand logo overlay
inputs.help: Overlay the brand logo on the result. Off by default.

inputs.label: Logo colour
inputs.help: White and green read on dark or busy footage; black suits light backgrounds.

inputs.label: Logo size
inputs.help: Scale the logo up or down.

inputs.label: Lower-third name card
inputs.help: A gently-animated name card that draws in over the footage. Uses your profile name & headshot.

inputs.label: Role / subtitle
inputs.help: Optional line below the name - e.g. a role or event.

inputs.label: Name weight
inputs.help: Font weight of the name line (100 Thin → 900 Black).

inputs.label: Subtitle weight
inputs.help: Font weight of the role / subtitle line (100 Thin → 900 Black).

inputs.label: Headshot (optional)
inputs.help: Defaults to your profile headshot. Pick or upload another to override.

inputs.label: Camera resolution
inputs.help: Working resolution for live-camera mode (Go live). Higher is sharper but heavier; no effect on a still image.
